name: MsoFontLanguageIndex
description: Represents one of the three language fonts contained in the ThemeFonts collection.

constants.name: msoThemeComplexScript
constants.description: Represents the font face for Complex Script languages. The Complex Script language collection supports Arabic, Georgian, Hebrew, Indian, Thai, and Vietnamese alphabets.

constants.name: msoThemeEastAsian
constants.description: Represents the East Asian font face. East Asian Languages include Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
